responsibility: This header declares GCC’s abstraction for deferred source-location lookup within string literals. The substring_loc class records a string’s overall location, type, and substring indices without immediately reparsing source text, while format_string_diagnostic_t bundles that information with optional labels, parameter locations, and replacement text for emitting format-related diagnostics. It also declares the helper used by front ends implementing LANG_HOOKS_GET_SUBSTRING_LOCATION.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/substring-locations.cc, which contains the warning-emission and location-resolution logic, this header defines the data abstractions and API surface: the substring_loc and format_string_diagnostic_t classes and the helper declaration used by LANG_HOOKS_GET_SUBSTRING_LOCATION implementations.
